video.title: <video> Video
video.history:
For video embedding

The <video> tag is used to embed video content in a webpage.
video.tip: The <video> tag is used to embed video content in a webpage.

source.title: <source> Media Source Tag
source.history:
Specifies and defines multiple media resources for media elements like

The <source> tag is used to specify multiple media resources for media elements.
source.tip: The <source> tag is used to specify multiple media resources for media elements.
source.code:
<video controls>
  <source src='movie.mp4' type='video/mp4'>
  <source src='movie.ogg' type='video/ogg'>
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
</video>

track.title: <track> Text Track Tag
track.history:
Used to specify text tracks, subtitles, captions, or descriptions for media elements like

The <track> tag is used to specify text tracks for media elements.
track.tip: The <track> tag is used to specify text tracks for media elements.
track.code:
<video controls>
  <source src='movie.mp4' type='video/mp4'>
  <track src='subtitles_en.vtt' kind='subtitles' srclang='en' label='English'>
  <track src='subtitles_fr.vtt' kind='subtitles' srclang='fr' label='French'>
</video>

section.title: <section> Section Tag
section.history:
Defines a section in a document.

The <section> tag is used to define a section in a document.

aside.title: <aside> Aside Tag
aside.history:
Defines content aside from the page content.

The <aside> tag is used to define content that is not directly related to the main content of the page.
aside.tip: The <aside> tag is used to define content that is not directly related to the main content of the page.
aside.code:
My family and I visited The Epcot center this summer. The weather was nice, and Epcot was amazing! I had a great summer together with my family!

Epcot Center

Epcot is a theme park at Walt Disney World Resort featuring exciting attractions, international pavilions, award-winning fireworks and seasonal special events.

header.title: <header> Header Tag

footer.title: <footer> Footer Tag
footer.history: Defines a container for footer content like author info, copyright, or links.
footer.tip: The <footer> tag is used to define the footer of a webpage. It typically contains copyright information, author info, or other supplementary content.
footer.code:
© 2025 My Website. All rights reserved.
